title: acknowledgement and resolution are measured from when the incident opened
question: does a service that escalated three times get to report a two-minute acknowledgement?
rule: MTTA is from the OPEN instant, not from the last page — src/stats.js
An average over nothing is null rather than nought.

steps.name: back to the seed, whose history is two acknowledgements at 120s and 60s and one close at 2460s
the seeded averages are those, and nothing else
a new page opens on platform

body.summary: Edge timeouts on two points of presence

steps.name: four minutes pass before anybody looks at it
imani takes it, 240 seconds after it opened
so the average of 120, 60 and 240 is 140
two minutes later it is closed, 360 seconds after it opened

body.note: traffic shifted away from both points of presence

steps.name: and the resolution average is the mean of 2460 and 360
